content.title-intro: NP NAPHTHA Production and Trading Company Limited
content.body-intro2: Our products at NP NAPHTHA are a combination of advanced technology and high quality raw materials. content.commited: We are committed to maintaining quality in the manufacturing process and providing professional customer support. We are not only committed to providing high quality products but also putting the living and working environment in focus. To fulfill this commitment, we apply the '3R - Reduce, Reuse, Recycle' principle strictly in our production process. We optimize production processes to limit defective products, minimize waste and save resources. At the same time, we also take advantage of material recycling during the production process, thereby minimizing negative impacts on the environment and society. We believe that protecting the environment is not only our responsibility but also a necessary task to maintain balance and sustainability for our planet.
content.exp: With a wealth of experience, NP NAPHTHA has brought to itself a large network of partners and customers from local businesses to leading international corporations, successfully conquering difficult markets such as Japan. Customer satisfaction is both proof of our production quality and the greatest source of encouragement for us to develop and improve every day.
